title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: wellness-reimbursement annual-cap headroom
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, an enrollment's cumulative wellness-reimbursement waivers in the trailing 12 months ending at the time of a new waiver, including that new waiver itself, may not exceed the tier's annual wellness-reimbursement cap. The remaining annual-cap headroom available to a new waiver is the annual cap minus the sum of wellness-reimbursement waivers already granted on that enrollment in the trailing 12 months, floored at zero so headroom is never negative.

Worked example (hypothetical): if a tier's annual wellness-reimbursement cap were $180.00 and $160.00 of wellness-reimbursement waivers had already been granted on the enrollment in the trailing 12 months, the remaining headroom would be $20.00. If instead $200.00 had already been granted against that same $180.00 cap, the remaining headroom would be floored at $0.00 rather than a negative figure.
